Switch Switch Q1: What is a switch? A switch is a networking device used to connect multiple devices such as computers, servers, and printers within a local area network (LAN), ensuring efficient data transfer and network performance. Q2: What brands of switches are commonly used? Popular brands include Cisco, Huawei, Aruba, D-Link, TP-Link, Netgear, Juniper, HPE, and Ruijie. Q3: What is a PoE (Power over Ethernet) switch? A PoE switch provides both data connection and electrical power through the same Ethernet cable ideal for powering devices like IP cameras, access points, and VoIP phones. Q4: Can I use multiple switches in one network? Yes. You can connect multiple switches to expand your network. However, make sure they are properly configured to avoid loops and performance issues. Q5: Can I use multiple switches in one network? When you connect multiple switches together using Ethernet cables, they expand your network by allowing more devices to communicate. Q6: What are the benefits of using a managed switch? They offer better network performance, traffic management, monitoring, and security control. Router Router Q1: What is a router? A router is a networking device that connects multiple networks together — it directs data packets between your local network (LAN) and the internet (WAN). Q2: What are the types of routers? Wired routers – connect devices using Ethernet cables. Wireless routers – provide Wi-Fi access to devices. Core routers – used by ISPs and large organizations for high-speed backbone connections. Q3: What is a PoE (Power over Ethernet) switch? A PoE switch provides both data connection and electrical power through the same Ethernet cable ideal for powering devices like IP cameras, access points, and VoIP phones. Q4: Can I use two routers in one network? Yes, but you must configure them correctly (e.g., disable DHCP on the second router or use it as an access point) to avoid IP conflicts. Q5: What is a dual-band router? A dual-band router operates on 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz frequencies, providing better performance and less interference. Q6: What are some trusted router brands? Popular brands include Cisco, TP-Link, D-Link, Netgear, MikroTik, and Ubiquiti.
